# The remedy tool runs in the test binary. It follows the exit codes of beehave.
exec remedy --help
stdout '^  size '
stdout '^  report '
! stdout '^  cut '
! stdout '^  integration '
! stdout '^  sync '
! stdout '^  board '
! stdout '^  take '
! stdout '^  scope '
! stdout '^  papers '
! stdout '^  audit '
! stdout '^  job '

# An unknown command is a refusal: exit code 2.
! exec remedy bake
stderr 'unknown command "bake"'

# A commit file with no finding passes.
exec remedy authors authors.txt --email me@example.com --login me
stdout 'author check: 1 commits, 1 ours and correctly addressed'

# A read of the forge with no origin remote is a refusal.
cd tree
! exec remedy recount --pr 1
stderr 'cannot read the origin remote'

# The subcommands that the engine runs as steps are not in the tool.
! exec remedy cut --old staging/r-I --new staging/r-II --pr 1
stderr 'unknown command "cut"'
! exec remedy integration --base staging/r-I --into main
stderr 'unknown command "integration"'
! exec remedy sync --base staging/r-I
stderr 'unknown command "sync"'
! exec remedy board --board 3 --status Done --pr 1
stderr 'unknown command "board"'
! exec remedy take 7 --me me --idle 1 --grace 1
stderr 'unknown command "take"'

# The subcommands that nothing calls are not in the tool.
! exec remedy scope 7 --state .
stderr 'unknown command "scope"'
! exec remedy papers HEAD..HEAD
stderr 'unknown command "papers"'
! exec remedy audit authored HEAD..HEAD
stderr 'unknown command "audit"'
! exec remedy job job.sh --list gate.md
stderr 'unknown command "job"'

-- authors.txt --
abc1234 me@example.com me
